description: Buy a listing from anywhere on the network, settled in USDC on Base, without leaving this connector. Pass the seller_mcp_url and product_id from the listing (mcp_ref). For physical products include the full delivery block; for event passes include the attendee block; the call rejects with the missing fields listed if any are blank. Free passes are not bought here: use claim_pass. Returns the total, an order_ref and a pay_url. SIMPLEST, for VIA and network-member listings alike: if you hold a standard x402 wallet (MoonPay PayBox: call use_service with url = pay_url; or any exact-scheme x402 client), request pay_url and pay its 402; the order settles and is fulfilled in that one call, gas sponsored. Otherwise: VIA-native orders settle at the /api/x402/purchase endpoint returned (EIP-2612 permit as { order_ref, x_payment }, or a raw USDC transfer as { order_ref, payment_tx_hash }); member orders take a raw USDC transfer then confirm_purchase. Call get_shipping_quote first and pass buyer_country to include shipping. Physical network-member listings: pass delivery; the first call returns shipping options, call again with shipping_rate_handle set to the one you chose.

country.description: Attendee country (name or ISO code), for the organiser.

email.description: Email the organiser will send the pass and any follow-up to.

name.description: Full name of the person the pass is for.

buyer_agent_id.description: ERC-8004 agent id of the Buying Agent acting on the buyer's behalf.

buyer_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 destination country. Required when the seller ships; folds the shipping quote into the total.

buyer_email.description: Network-member orders: email for the order confirmation and file delivery. Required for physical member products.

buyer_wallet.description: The buyer wallet that will settle in USDC on Base.

delivery.description: Required for physical products. Omit for digital / service.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must match buyer_country if both are supplied

selected_color.description: Variant colour, for network-member products that have a colour axis. Ignored by VIA-native listings.

selected_size.description: Variant size, for network-member products that have a size axis (e.g. S, M, L). Ignored by VIA-native listings.

seller_mcp_url.description: mcp_ref.seller_mcp_url from a find_seller / get_seller_products result.

shipping_rate_handle.description: Network-member physical products only: the shipping option handle from a previous buy_product call. Omit on the first call to get the options.

name: buy_product
